versions.short: The joint resolution would revoke the partial authorization the Environmental Protection Agency gave to the California Air Resources Board to amend its regulation on commercial harbor craft. The amendments would have set new emission standards and compliance dates based on vessel category and engine model year, and would have expanded the types of vessels covered, such as commercial fishing boats. Under the Clean Air Act, the EPA may allow California to adopt and enforce its own standards for emissions from nonroad vehicles and engines if those standards meet certain requirements. The resolution would nullify the EPA decision titled California State Nonroad Engine Pollution Control Standards; Commercial Harbor Craft Regulations; Notice of Decision.
